gold: Fibrofatty residua of involuted infantile hemangioma

selector.rationale: The presence of a skin-colored, exophytic, soft, oval tumor with overlying pinpoint vessels and branching telangiectasia, along with the composition of mature adipose and fibrous tissues, supports the diagnosis of Nevus lipomatosus superficialis.

rejected.label: Fibrolipoma
rejected.why: Less supportive evidence and lower score compared to the champion and runner-up.

rejected.label: Lipofibromatosis
rejected.why: Although it has a higher score, the specific characteristics of the lesion and histological findings better align with Nevus lipomatosus superficialis.
